portInfo.description: Port of Bodø states it collaborates with Visit Bodø and local tourism on sustainable cruise development and notes membership in Cruise Europe, Cruise Norway and Cruise Northern Norway and Svalbard (CNNS). The captured English cruise page does not publish a berth length/depth table, so this guide keeps the landing at port-area precision with null door GPS. Postal address Postboks 138, 8001 Bodø; visiting Bodøterminalen 4th floor, Rønvikleira; +47 75 55 10 80; firmapost@bodohavn.no.

climate.rainySeason: Year-round with higher precipitation in autumn
climate.description: Subarctic climate with cool summers and cold winters

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.
